why is the ups flagged?.text: The UPS (EQ-UPS-02) is flagged because submittal SUB-002 (VOLT-UPS-400) declares a capacity of 400 kW, whereas clause CL-4.2 requires a rated capacity of not less than 500 kW [SUB-002]. This leaves the rating 100 kW (20%) below the specification [SUB-002].

evidence.title: UPS rated capacity
evidence.text: Each UPS module (UPS-02) shall have a rated output of not less than 500 kW.

steps: Examine the factory test reports for UPS-02.
Verify the output capacity rating listed on the UPS module's identification plate.
evidence.acceptance: The rated output is confirmed to be at least 500 kW.

evidence.title: UPS efficiency
evidence.text: UPS-02 shall achieve an efficiency of not less than 96 % in double-conversion mode at full load.

evidence.title: EQ-UPS-02 rating below spec
evidence.text: EQ-UPS-02 (UPS module) is flagged because submittal SUB-002 (VOLT-UPS-400) declares 400 kW, but clause CL-4.2 (UPS rated capacity) requires >= 500 kW. That is 100 kW (20%) below spec. It affects 6 schedule tasks: TASK-009, TASK-015, TASK-017, TASK-028, TASK-030, TASK-031. It also affects 4 tests: T-L1-002, T-L5-003, T-L5-004, T-L5-005.

what does the chiller delay affect?.text: Based on the provided context, the delay of PO-008 for EQ-CHL-01 affects 7 schedule tasks (TASK-010, TASK-011, TASK-012, TASK-013, TASK-014, TASK-015, and TASK-031) and 5 tests (T-L1-008, T-L4-005, T-L5-003, T-L5-004, and T-L5-005) [PO-008]. It also causes the planned handover date of 2027-06-22 to move 47 days later to 2027-08-08 [PO-008].

evidence.title: Chiller cooling capacity
evidence.text: The water-cooled chiller (CHL-01) shall have a cooling capacity of not less than 1200 kW.

steps: Run CHL-01 in a controlled factory test environment at full load conditions.
Measure the chilled water flow rate and the temperature difference between the inlet and outlet.
Calculate the total cooling capacity in kW based on the measured thermal data.
evidence.acceptance: The calculated cooling capacity is at least 1200 kW.

evidence.title: Cooling restart after transfer
evidence.text: After a transfer to generator power, CHL-01 shall resume cooling within not more than 120 seconds.

steps: Initiate a simulated utility power failure to trigger a transfer to generator power.
Start a stopwatch the moment the Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) completes the transfer to the generator.
Stop the timer when CHL-01 confirms compressor restart and begins active cooling.
evidence.acceptance: The time elapsed from power transfer to cooling resumption is 120 seconds or less.

evidence.title: Cooling fault tolerance
evidence.text: A single failure in the cooling path shall not reduce available cooling capacity below 100 % of the design load (CHL-01).

steps: Apply the full design heat load to the data center using load banks.
Induce a single point of failure in the cooling distribution path, such as closing a critical valve or tripping a pump breaker.
Observe if the system maintains the design load without any degradation in cooling performance.
evidence.acceptance: The cooling capacity remains at 100% of the design load despite the induced single failure.

evidence.title: Chiller efficiency
evidence.text: CHL-01 shall achieve a coefficient of performance (COP) of not less than 5.5 at full load.

steps: Operate the chiller at 100% cooling load for a minimum of 30 minutes.
Record the electrical power input (kW) using the power meter.
Calculate cooling output using the measured chilled water flow and temperature differential.
Divide the cooling output by the power input to determine the COP.
evidence.acceptance: The calculated Coefficient of Performance (COP) must be 5.5 or higher.

evidence.title: Chilled water supply temperature
evidence.text: CHL-01 shall deliver chilled water at a supply temperature of 18 degC.

evidence.title: Cooling redundancy (N+1)
evidence.text: The cooling plant shall include not fewer than 1 standby chiller, so that full capacity is maintained when any one chiller is out of service (CHL-01).

steps: Run the cooling plant at its maximum required facility load.
Manually shut down one operational chiller (CHL-01) to simulate a failure.
Monitor the remaining chillers to ensure they pick up the load without a loss in cooling capacity.
evidence.acceptance: The cooling plant maintains 100% of the required cooling load after the standby chiller takes over.

evidence.title: PO-008 delivery is 47 days late
evidence.text: PO-008 (ThermoCore Systems) for EQ-CHL-01 (Water-cooled chiller) promises delivery on 2027-06-01, but TASK-010 needs it by 2027-04-15. It is 47 days late. The chiller is on the critical path, so the planned handover date 2027-06-22 moves to 2027-08-08, which is 47 days later. It affects 7 schedule tasks: TASK-010, TASK-011, TASK-012, TASK-013, TASK-014, TASK-015, TASK-031. It also affects 5 tests: T-L1-008, T-L4-005, T-L5-003, T-L5-004, T-L5-005.
